welcome.eyebrow: Write at the speed of thought
welcome.title: Welcome to Open Dictate
welcome.description: Turn your voice into polished text everywhere.
welcome.detail: Hold one shortcut, speak naturally, and your finished text appears in any app.
welcome.privacy: Your audio is processed only to create your text.

language.title: Choose your languages
language.description: Set the interface language and the language you will usually speak before Open Dictate starts.
language.interfaceDescription: Menus, settings, and onboarding use this language.
language.speechDescription: Dictation starts with this language, and you can change it later in Settings.

mode.title: Choose how to use Open Dictate
mode.description: Choose your own API key, fully private Local AI, or the managed Pro experience.

free.title: Free without account
free.description: Use your own OpenAI API key. No account or subscription required.
free.featureThree: Key stored securely on this device

local.title: Local AI
local.description: Completely free and private after a one-time model download.
local.featureOne: Audio and text stay on this device
local.featureThree: No account, API key, or subscription

pro.title: Open Dictate Pro
pro.description: $5/month includes a fixed monthly token allowance.

setup.title: Set up your experience
setup.description: Your credentials are protected and never shown in the interface after setup.

apiKey.title: Connect your OpenAI API key
apiKey.description: Your key is encrypted and stored privately on this device.
apiKey.label: OpenAI API key
apiKey.invalid: We couldn't validate this API key. Check it and try again.

local.title: Choose Local AI quality
local.description: Download the model pair that best matches this device. You can change it later in Settings.

account.title: Create your account
